reviews.title: Unified Channels, Precision Engagement
reviews.text: I love how Braze has united our applications, logins, and event data so a fan's full history is in a single view, making the consolidation invaluable to me. I appreciate the precision in carving out the right audience and delivering the right message at the right moment. The approachability of Braze's interface really stands out, allowing me to build campaigns unaided. I find the integrations straightforward, which helps our data team incorporate Braze into our wider reporting. I also value Braze's timing intelligence, which schedules messages to land when fans are most likely to engage, boosting response rates for our campaigns. I find the content cards limiting because they don't support HTML, which restricts us when we want richer, polished creative. I also found the initial installation challenging, as it required significant involvement from our product and development colleagues.

reviews.title: Streamlined Multi-Channel Engagement with Braze
reviews.text: I like how flexible and easy Braze makes it to build personalized customer journeys. I find Canvas to be one of my favorite features because it simplifies creating and visualizing complex user flows. Liquid allows me to personalize messages based on customer data without any complications. I also appreciate the powerful segmentation, real-time event tracking, and the ability to manage multiple communication channels from one platform. The interface is intuitive, and I can launch campaigns quickly. The reporting tools are helpful in measuring performance and optimizing campaigns over time. One area that could be improved is the Revenue Dashboard. In my experience, the revenue figures don't always align with our internal reporting, which can make it difficult to rely on the dashboard for accurate revenue analysis. Better attribution, improved data accuracy, and more transparent reporting would make this feature much more useful. Other than that, Braze has been a solid platform for managing and automating customer engagement campaigns.

reviews.title: Powerful multi-channel engagement platform
reviews.text: Braze spent the last year really expanding their AI toolset. The big ones include Decisioning Studio (basically AI instead of manual A/B testing), an Agent Console for building custom AI agents right in Canvas, and a Content Optimizer that auto-generates message variants per person. They also added new channels (RCS, WhatsApp Commerce, Banners), zero-copy warehouse data triggers, and automated email IP warming. Lots of it looks promising, but most of the AI features are still in beta and pretty enterprise-focused. While Braze is a powerful platform, there are a few areas where it could improve. The biggest gap is reporting. There's solid high-level engagement data, but no holistic way to see the cumulative impact of my lifecycle programs, so I still rely on manual analysis to understand each campaign's incremental effect. Beyond that, the pricing model (metered by data points and MAUs) gets expensive. The platform also carries a steep learning curve and heavy QA burden thanks to its reliance on Liquid.
